messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis | Where to Watch |
|-------|------|----------|----------------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore presents scientific evidence on climate change, its impacts, and solutions. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |
| **An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power** | 2017 | A follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film, featuring new data and interviews with scientists and activists. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to meet leaders, scientists, and communities affected by climate change, highlighting urgent actions needed. | Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, iTunes |
| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Producer George Lucas and environmentalist Nicholas Roeg interview scientists, activists, and business leaders about the state of Earth’s ecosystems. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes |
| **Our Planet** (Series) | 2019 | Narrated by Sir David Attenborough, this series showcases stunning wildlife footage while explaining how climate change threatens biodiversity. | Netflix |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2020 | A short, fact‑based overview produced by the BBC, summarizing key science and policy issues. | YouTube (BBC News), iTunes |

These films provide a mix of scientific explanations, personal stories, and calls to action. They’re widely available on major streaming platforms or can be rented/bought digitally. Enjoy watching!
